([[Metuchen, New Jersey]]) | college = [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt]] (2014–2016) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = *Second-team All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] (2016) }} '''Wade Manson Baldwin IV''' (born March 29, 1996) is an American [[basketball]] player who recently completed his college career for the [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt Commodores]]. Born in the [[Belle Mead, New Jersey|Belle Mead]] section of [[Montgomery Township, New Jersey]], Baldwin attended [[Immaculata High School (New Jersey)|Immaculata High School]] in [[Somerville, New Jersey]] and transferred to [[St. Joseph High School (Metuchen, New Jersey)|St. Joseph High School]] in [[Metuchen, New Jersey]] prior to his junior year.[http://highschoolsports.nj.com/news/article/-3722114737471411577/boys-basketball-tournament-of-champions-semifinal-preview-st-joseph-met-vs-linden-the-wade-baldwin-story/ Boys basketball Tournament of Champions preview, St. Joseph (Metuchen): The Wade Baldwin Story] He committed to [[Vanderbilt University]] to play [[college basketball]].[http://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2013/09/01/three-star-guard-wade-baldwin-commits-to-vanderbilt/ Three-star guard Wade Baldwin commits to Vanderbilt] As a freshman at Vanderbilt, Baldwin started 24 of 35 games and averaged 9.3 points, 4.1 rebounds, and 4.4 assists per game. He had a Vanderbilt freshman record 155 assists.[http://www.nashvillepost.com/sports/vanderbilt-athletics/blog/20490304/baldwin-climbing-school-conference-assists-lists Baldwin climbing school, conference assists lists][http://www.tennessean.com/story/sports/college/vanderbilt/2015/12/25/wade-baldwin-serves-vanderbilts-challenger/76930228/ Wade Baldwin serves as Vanderbilt's 'challenger'] On March 28, Baldwin declared for the 2016 NBA Draft [http://www.cbssports.com/collegebasketball/eye-on-college-basketball/25533964/vanderbilts-wade-baldwin-declares-for-nba-draft-what-you-need-to-know Baldwin declared for the 2016 NBA Draft] while announcing he would be hiring an agent and staying in the draft. He is a favorite of analytics-oriented scouts [http://www.deepishthoughts.com/kaisers-2016-draft-preliminary-top-30/ a favorite of analytics-oriented scouts] {{Cite web|url=http://www.deepishthoughts.com/kaisers-2016-draft-preliminary-top-30/|title=Kaiser’s Draft Notes IX: 2016 Draft Preliminary Top 30 {{!}} Deep(ish) Thoughts|date=2016-05-01|website=Deep(ish) Thoughts|language=en-US|access-date=2016-05-07}} and is expected to go within the top 20 picks. ==Personal life== His father, Wade Baldwin III, had previously worked under the [[CIA]]. ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links{{Cite web|url=http://www.cbssports.com/collegebasketball/eye-on-college-basketball/25533964/vanderbilts-wade-baldwin-declares-for-nba-draft-what-you-need-to-know|title=Vanderbilt's Wade Baldwin to declare for NBA Draft: What you need to know|website=CBSSports.com|access-date=2016-05-07}}== *[http://www.vucommodores.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/wade_baldwin_iv_910366.html Vanderbilt Commodores bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Baldwin, Wade}} [[Category:1996 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from New Jersey]] [[Category:People from Montgomery Township, New Jersey]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball players]]
